title: Decide: order physical polo samples before committing to a tier
detail: Before going to private label (Tier 3), you should hold the actual fabric. Recommend ordering: (1) Adidas A430 sample from Printful via the BV store as a $30 test order, (2) one TM "Heater" polo retail at $98 as the benchmark, (3) one Peter Millar polo at $125 as the aspirational benchmark. Total ~$253. Compare side-by-side. This decides whether Adidas A430 is "good enough" for v1 or whether you need to skip straight to Tier 2 (Apliiq) or Tier 3 (Peru/Vietnam).
why: Sample evaluation is a tactile, subjective decision — I can identify suppliers and read spec sheets but can't judge fabric hand.
